exercises.why: **издаёт** — издава́ть (imperfective): to publish, to print; to edit; to issue, to promulgate, to enact; to utter, to emit, to exhale. Wiktionary: изда́ть + -ва́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **удаётся** — удава́ться (imperfective): to turn out well, to be a success; (impersonal) to succeed. Wiktionary: уда́ться + -ва́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to give out, to pay out, to hand, to issue, to distribute
to turn out well, to be a success
to set, to assign (an exercise or lesson)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: выдава́ть — to give out, to pay out, to hand, to issue, to distribute; издава́ть — to publish, to print; удава́ться — to turn out well, to be a success; зада́ть — to set, to assign (an exercise or lesson).
**Задай** — зада́ть (perfective): to set, to assign (an exercise or lesson); to ask (a question); to pose (a problem); (colloquial) to give, to throw (a dinner or banquet). Wiktionary: за- + дать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
